annotations.title: Can a company from this country bid there?

description: Whether a company based in one country may bid for public tenders in another country (trade agreements, foreign-bidder rules, registrations needed). Give a tender_id or the tender's country. Use when the user asks whether a company from one country can bid on, or take part in, public tenders in another country.

company_country.description: Where the bidding company is based: name or ISO code.

tender_country.description: Country of the tenders: name or ISO code (not needed if tender_id is given).

tender_id.description: Optional askTender tender id; its country and scope are used.
